title: Numbers up to 1000
description: Class 2 IMO — Numbers up to 1000: place value, number names, comparing and ordering, even and odd, with olympiad reasoning and everyday-maths practice.

topics.title: Place Value (Hundreds, Tens, Ones)
topics.concept:
A 3-digit number is made of hundreds, tens and ones. In 345, the 3 means 3 hundreds (300), the 4 means 4 tens (40) and the 5 means 5 ones (5). So 345 = 300 + 40 + 5.

The place of a digit tells its value. In 528, the digit 5 is in the hundreds place and stands for 500.

examples.problem: What is the place value of 7 in 472?
examples.solution: 7 is in the tens place, so its value is 70.

recap: The place of a digit gives its value (e.g. 5 in 528 = 500).

quiz.q: What is the place value of 9 in 902?
quiz.explanation: 9 is in the hundreds place, so its value is 900.

topics.title: Comparing and Ordering Numbers
topics.concept:
To compare 3-digit numbers, first compare the hundreds. If they are equal, compare the tens, then the ones. We write > for greater than and < for less than.

To order numbers, put them smallest to largest (ascending) or largest to smallest (descending).
recap: Compare hundreds first, then tens, then ones.
> means greater than; < means less than.

quiz.explanation: 750 has 7 hundreds and 5 tens — the largest.

topics.title: Even, Odd and Skip Counting
topics.concept: A number is even if it ends in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8, and odd if it ends in 1, 3, 5, 7 or 9. Skip counting helps us count fast: by 2s, 5s, 10s and 100s. We also use just before, just after and between to place numbers.

examples.solution: It ends in 4, so it is even.

recap: Even ends in 0/2/4/6/8; odd ends in 1/3/5/7/9.
Skip count by 2s, 5s, 10s, 100s to count faster.

quiz.explanation: 58 ends in 8, so it is even.

questions.q: Which number is the odd one out:  246, 138, 460, 591 (three are even)?
questions.explanation: 591 ends in 1 (odd); the others are even.

questions.q: If 1 hundred = 10 tens, then 3 hundreds = ___ tens?
What is the place value of 6 in 760?
questions.explanation: 6 is in the tens place, value 60.

questions.q: A shop has number plates 230 to 240. How many plates is that in all?
Riya counts steps in 5s: 5, 10, 15, 20. How many steps has she counted to reach 20?
A book has pages numbered up to 150. Is 150 even or odd?
questions.explanation: 150 ends in 0, so it is even.

questions.q: Make the largest 3-digit number using the digits 4, 7 and 2 (each once).
I am a number between 30 and 40. I am even and my ones digit is 6. Who am I?
questions.explanation: Between 30 and 40 with ones digit 6 is 36.
